title: Add verUSD to globalfee module
description: Add the Verona USD token factory denomination (factory/xion17grq736740r70awldugfs3mls3stu9haewctv2/verusd, display verUSD, 6 decimals) to the globalfee module's MinimumGasPricesParam so that transaction fees may be paid in verUSD. The minimum gas price is set to 0.005 verUSD per unit of gas, matching the existing Noble $USDC rate. MinimumGasPricesParam is replaced in full, so the existing entries are restated unchanged: Noble $USDC (ibc/6490A7EAB61059BFC1CDDEB05917DD70BDF3A611654162A1A47DB930D40D8AF4) at 0.005 and uxion at 0.001. Denominations are listed in ascending order as required by the module's parameter validation. No other globalfee parameters are changed: BypassMinFeeMsgTypes and MaxTotalBypassMinFeeMsgGasUsage are untouched.
